title: Serve It Worldwide
style: afrobeat jazz fusion, female lead vocal, live percussion, horn section, upbeat 96 BPM, call and response, multilingual coaching anthem, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO - percussion build]
(spoken)
The serve needs no translation.
Deep. Routine. Every time.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Toes behind the line, paddle low
Pick your target, let it go
Deep to the backhand, deep to the T
Routine every serve, consistency

[VERSE 2 - Italian]
Piedi dietro la linea, pagaia bassa
Scegli il bersaglio, lascia andare
Profondo al rovescio, profondo alla T
Ogni servizio uguale, regolarita

[VERSE 3 - Korean]
Line dwi e bal eul noh go
Paedeu natkge, mokpyo jeonghae
Back haen deu gipge, T jon gipge
Rutin ma da gatke, consistency

[CHORUS]
SERVE - SERVIZIO - SERVE - HUDUMA
DEEP AND ROUTINE - EVERY TIME
SET THE TONE - HOLD THE LINE

[VERSE 4 - Arabic transliteration]
Qadaman khalf al khatt, al midrab munkhafid
Ikhtar hadafak, wa dah idhab
Ameeq ila al khalfiya, ameeq ila T
Kull irsaal nafs al iqa, al ittisaq

[VERSE 5 - Dutch]
Voeten achter de lijn, peddel laag
Kies je doel, laat het gaan
Diep naar de backhand, diep naar de T
Elke serve hetzelfde, consistentie

[VERSE 6 - Swahili]
Miguu nyuma ya mstari, pala chini
Chagua lengo lako, acha iende
Mrefu kwa backhand, mrefu kwa T
Kila seva sawa, uthabiti

[CHORUS]
SERVE - SERVIZIO - SERVE - HUDUMA
DEEP AND ROUTINE - EVERY TIME
SET THE TONE - HOLD THE LINE

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Three bounces. One breath.
In every language, same truth.
The serve is yours. Own it.

[FINAL CHORUS]
SERVE - SERVIZIO - SERVE - HUDUMA
DEEP AND ROUTINE - EVERY TIME
SET THE TONE - EVERY TIME - HOLD THE LINE

[OUTRO - percussion fade]
Worldwide. One serve.
Starts here.
